risks: Minimal: secondary analysis of de-identified data inside a secure service; the main risk is misuse of a school-level result to stigmatise schools.
consent: The survey's own consent covered research use; no new consent is sought, subject to the custodian's governance.
data: No student or school identities leave the custodian's service; only aggregate model outputs are released.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: place of residence (capital against regional towns) and socioeconomic position are central; estimates are reported by remoteness, and results will not be presented school by school.
effectiveness: Gives councils and the minister an honest estimate of the association, not of a cap's effect.
partnerships: Survey custodian, two councils drafting caps, a youth advisory group.
rebPath: State health department human research ethics committee review of secondary analysis, alongside the custodian's application process.
limitations: Cross-sectional; self-reported outcomes; incomplete vape retail exposure.
summary: Low-risk secondary analysis; care is needed in how school-level results are presented.
